scope_limits: Contractor, trainee and coordinator vocabulary does not establish employment status, qualifications, legal duties or delegated powers.
Helpful-person contact is distinct from communication verbs, information, methods/events and physical or clinical contact.
Point of contact and alternative contact may be persons or routes; unresolved background contexts gain no selected binding.
Specialist provider, role, work-period, appointment, financial-table and meeting compounds keep complete identities and all domain gates.
Remote or hybrid participation fits a discussion meeting, but a rendezvous point or hearing access link does not automatically establish that event sense.
